item.title: Coldcard firmware exploit drains $130M+ in bitcoin from ~5,000 hardware wallets; multiple threat actors targeting unpatched devices
BlackRock purchased $111M in BTC via IBIT on Aug. 3 as U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs resumed net buying after weeks of outflows
Ethereum ETFs attracted $3.87B in August, the first month ether ETF inflows surpassed bitcoin ETF inflows of roughly $750M
GENIUS Act stablecoin framework took effect July 18; OCC rules mandate 1:1 liquid USD reserves and two-day redemption for issuers
EU MiCA transitional period expired July 1; unauthorised crypto asset service providers barred from offering services to EU clients
U.S. Treasury proposed GENIUS Act AML rules designating permitted stablecoin issuers as financial institutions under the Bank Secrecy Act
FATF Travel Rule is enacted in 85 of 117 jurisdictions, with 2026 supervisory focus on stablecoins and unhosted wallets
Morgan Stanley launched MSBT on NYSE Arca as the first bank-issued spot bitcoin ETF, charging 0.14%, undercutting BlackRock IBIT
Citi targeting 2026 launch of institutional bitcoin and Ethereum custody, combining in-house infrastructure and third-party key management
OCC granted national trust bank charters to Circle, Paxos, and three other nonbank stablecoin issuers in December 2025
JPMorgan Kinexys tokenized collateral and payments platform processed $5B in daily transactions across five continents
Crypto hacks reached $1.3B across 276 incidents through mid-2026; Coldcard exploit ranked third-largest of the year per CertiK
Spot bitcoin ETFs recovered under 4% of $8.2B in mid-July outflows before fresh institutional buying resumed in August 2026
